content: When amlodipine is coadministered with CYP3A inhibitors, it may necessitate a reduction in dosage. Patients should be closely monitored for symptoms of hypotension and edema to determine if dose adjustments are required. Atazanavir enhances the effects of levobunolol through pharmacodynamic synergy. Caution is advised, and monitoring is necessary due to an increased risk of hypotension, bradycardia, atrioventricular (AV) block, and prolonged PR interval. Consider lowering the beta-blocker dose. Levoketoconazole increases the levels or effects of atazanavir by altering hepatic and intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Atazanavir increases the levels or effects of levomilnacipran by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are necessary. Do not exceed 80 mg/day of levomilnacipran when coadministered with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. Atazanavir may increase or decrease the levels of levonorgestrel (intrauterine or oral) by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are recommended. Alternatives should be considered if available. Atazanavir decreases the effects of linagliptin through mechanisms other than CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Atazanavir may also increase linagliptin levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Atazanavir decreases the effects of liraglutide through mechanisms other than CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution is advised due to reports of hyperglycemia caused by insulin resistance with protease inhibitors. Atazanavir increases the levels of lofepramine through an unspecified interaction mechanism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Atazanavir increases the levels or effects of lopinavir by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Atazanavir increases the levels or effects of loratadine by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Atazanavir increases the levels or effects of losartan by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Atazanavir increases the levels of lumacaftor/ivacaftor by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are necessary. When initiating lumacaftor/ivacaftor in patients taking strong CYP3A inhibitors, reduce the dose to one tablet daily for the first week to allow for steady-state induction effects of lumacaftor. No dose adjustment is required for moderate or weak CYP3A4 inhibitors. Atazanavir increases the levels or effects of lumateperone by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are necessary. Limit the dose to 5 mg/day when coadministered with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. Atazanavir increases the levels or effects of lumefantrine by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Atazanavir increases the levels or effects of lurasidone by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are necessary. The manufacturer recommends reducing the starting dose of lurasidone to 20 mg/day and limiting the maximum daily dose to 80 mg when coadministered with moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors. Atazanavir increases the levels of maprotiline through an unspecified interaction mechanism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Atazanavir increases the levels or effects of maraviroc by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Reduce the maraviroc dose to 150 mg twice daily when coadministered with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. Atazanavir increases the levels or effects of mavorizxafor by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are necessary. Mavorizxafor also increases atazanavir levels by inhibiting P-glycoprotein (MDR1) efflux transporters. Caution is advised when coadministering mavorizxafor with sensitive P-gp substrates. Atazanavir and medroxyprogesterone may decrease each other's effects by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are necessary. Alternatives should be considered if available. Atazanavir increases the levels of meperidine by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended due to the potential for increased toxicity. Atazanavir increases the levels or effects of mestranol by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Atazanavir decreases the effects of metformin through mechanisms other than CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended due to reports of hyperglycemia caused by insulin resistance with protease inhibitors. Atazanavir increases the levels or effects of methadone by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Atazanavir increases the levels or effects of methylprednisolone by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Atazanavir enhances the effects of metoprolol through pharmacodynamic synergy. Caution and monitoring are necessary due to an increased risk of hypotension, bradycardia, AV block, and prolonged PR interval. Consider lowering the beta-blocker dose. Atazanavir increases the levels or effects of midazolam by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Atazanavir increases the levels or effects of mifepristone by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are necessary. Do not exceed 300 mg/day of mifepristone for Cushing syndrome when coadministered with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. Atazanavir decreases the effects of miglitol through mechanisms other than CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended due to reports of hyperglycemia caused by insulin resistance with protease inhibitors. Atazanavir and mipomersen may increase each other's toxicity through mechanisms other than CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Both drugs have the potential to increase hepatic enzymes; monitor liver function tests (LFTs). Atazanavir increases the levels or effects of mirvetuximab soravtansine by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Coadministration with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors may increase exposure to unconjugated DM4, the cytotoxic component of mirvetuximab soravtansine, increasing the risk of adverse reactions. Mitotane decreases the levels of atazanavir by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Mitotane is a strong inducer of CYP3A4; monitor for possible dosage adjustments when coadministered with CYP3A4 substrates. Atazanavir increases the levels of mometasone (inhaled or intranasal) by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended due to the potential for increased toxicity, including an increased risk of Cushing's syndrome or adrenal suppression. Atazanavir enhances the effects of nadolol through pharmacodynamic synergy. Caution and monitoring are necessary due to an increased risk of hypotension, bradycardia, AV block, and prolonged PR interval. Consider lowering the beta-blocker dose. Atazanavir increases the levels of naldemedine by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Monitor for potential adverse effects if coadministered with strong or moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors. Atazanavir decreases the effects of nateglinide through mechanisms other than CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended due to reports of hyperglycemia caused by insulin resistance with protease inhibitors. Atazanavir enhances the effects of nebivolol through pharmacodynamic synergy. Caution and monitoring are necessary due to an increased risk of hypotension, bradycardia, AV block, and prolonged PR interval. Consider lowering the beta-blocker dose. Nefazodone increases the levels or effects of atazanavir by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Atazanavir increases the levels or effects of nelfinavir by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Both drugs increase the risk of immune reconstitution syndrome. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Atazanavir increases the levels or effects of netupitant/palonosetron by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Netupitant is primarily metabolized by CYP3A4; no dosage adjustment is required. Atazanavir and nevirapine both increase the risk of immune reconstitution syndrome. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Atazanavir increases the levels or effects of nicardipine by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Atazanavir increases the levels or effects of nilotinib by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Nirmatrelvir increases the levels or effects of atazanavir by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Patients on ritonaviror cobicistat-containing HIV regimens should continue their treatment as indicated. Monitor for increased adverse events associated with nirmatrelvir/ritonavir or protease inhibitors. Atazanavir increases the levels or effects of nisoldipine by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Atazanavir may increase or decrease the levels of norelgesteromin, norgestimate, or norethindrone by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are necessary. Alternatives should be considered if available. Atazanavir increases the levels of norgestrel by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Strong or moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors may increase systemic concentrations of norgestrel, raising the risk of adverse effects. Atazanavir increases the levels of nortriptyline through an unspecified interaction mechanism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Atazanavir increases the levels or effects of oliceridine by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are necessary. Less frequent oliceridine dosing may be required. Monitor for respiratory depression and sedation, and adjust subsequent doses accordingly. If the inhibitor is discontinued, consider increasing the oliceridine dosage until stable drug effects are achieved. Monitor for signs of opioid withdrawal. Atazanavir increases the levels or effects of ombitasvir/paritaprevir/ritonavir & dasabuvir (DSC) by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are necessary. Increased levels of paritaprevir occur when coadministered with atazanavir/ritonavir; administer atazanavir 300 mg (without ritonavir) in the morning when coadministered with Viekira Pak. Atazanavir increases the levels or effects of ondansetron by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. CYP450 inhibitors may decrease the clearance of ondansetron. However, no dosage adjustment for ondansetron is recommended. Orlistat decreases the levels or effects of atazanavir by inhibiting gastrointestinal absorption. This applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Caution and monitoring are advised. Loss of virological control has been reported in HIV-infected patients taking orlistat concomitantly. Monitor HIV RNA levels frequently, and if increased viral load is confirmed, discontinue orlistat. Atazanavir increases the levels or effects of osilodrostat by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are necessary. Reduce the osilodrostat dose by half when coadministered with a strong CYP3A4 inhibitor. Atazanavir increases the levels of ospemifene by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Atazanavir increases the levels of panobinostat by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are necessary. Reduce the panobinostat starting dose to 10 mg if coadministered with strong CYP3A4 inhibitors. Atazanavir increases the levels of paricalcitol by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised due to the potential for increased toxicity. Atazanavir enhances the effects of penbutolol through pharmacodynamic synergy. Caution and monitoring are necessary due to an increased risk of hypotension, bradycardia, AV block, and prolonged PR interval. Consider lowering the beta-blocker dose. Atazanavir increases the levels or effects of perampanel by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Atazanavir enhances the effects of pindolol through pharmacodynamic synergy. Caution and monitoring are necessary due to an increased risk of hypotension, bradycardia, AV block, and prolonged PR interval. Consider lowering the beta-blocker dose. Atazanavir increases the levels or effects of polatuzumab vedotin by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are recommended. Polatuzumab undergoes catabolism to small peptides, amino acids, monomethyl auristatin E (MMAE), and unconjugated MMAE-related catabolites. MMAE is a CYP3A4 substrate.
